notes: Two bullets, three rungs. Bullet 1 carries both the talk and the gather ('After speaking with Wyatt, collect four Ladybug Wings'), so it splits: the visit to Wyatt is step 1 and the collecting is step 2. The gather step is worth its own rung because holding four wings is genuinely observable, which is what moves the mark on to the hand-in. It gets no zone and no monster: the only thing the page says about where wings come from is the sub-bullet 'Wings drop from any ladybug' -- a family, not a name, and no zone at all -- so naming one specific ladybug or one specific zone would be inventing precision the page does not have. Wyatt is in the PAST San d'Oria: 'Southern San d'Oria (S)' is written out in the Start field and resolves to zone 80, not the present-day 230. Item Reqs (4x Ladybug Wing) and the walkthrough agree on the count, so all four go in one trade.

notes: The page's two bullets are in the wrong order for a ladder: bullet 1 tells you to buy the skins and bullet 2 tells you to speak to Hanaa Punaa 'to start quest and then trade her the 3 skins'. Since nothing can be tracked before the quest is open, bullet 2 is split around bullet 1 -- talk, buy, trade -- and the source bullets record that inversion. The buy step is aimed at Cletae rather than left targetless: the page names her as the seller, she resolves, and that gives the gather rung a real marker. Her position is given only as 'in the building right behind her', which is a phrase and not a grid, so it stays in the note. The header description asks for 'three giant sheepskins', but Item Reqs and the walkthrough both say Sheepskin x3, and 'Giant Sheepskin' does not resolve as an item at all -- the description is loose flavour and Sheepskin is the real requirement.

Four bullets collapse to three rungs. Bullets 1 and 2 are one visit to Abioleget -- he asks, then you buy the peas from him for 70 gil -- and consecutive bullets on the same NPC are one marker, so they merge. The 70 gil is real but unmodellable: gil is not an item resource, so items stays empty and the cost lives in the note; recording it as a bare talk is more honest than a trade with nothing in it. The peas themselves ARE observable, so that merged step carries the evidence. Bullet 3 only locates Andelain, so it merges into the delivery in bullet 4, and bullet 4's second clause is the separate return to Abioleget -- one bullet feeding two steps.

One of the Mog Garden chain quests, and short. Bullet 3 ('You will automatically start the next quest after speaking to the moogle') is an outcome, not a step -- it restates what bullet 2 already did -- so it is dropped; a verb-scanner would have made a rung out of it. Mineral Vein is used because it is what the instruction says and it is the form that resolves; the description's wording is recorded here. notes: The one real trap in this batch, and it is a zone trap. This quest's Previous is Seeing Spots, which is a Crystal War quest given by Wyatt in Southern San d'Oria (S) at (L-6) -- and Atelloune is at (L-6) too. The matching grid plus the Wings of the Goddess tag makes it very tempting to read her into the past zone as well, which would put every marker on this quest in zone 80 instead of 230. Four things say otherwise and they all agree: the page writes the zone plainly as 'Southern San d'Oria' in both the Start field and bullet 1 and never once writes '(S)'; the wiki files it under Southern San d'Oria Quests rather than Southern San d'Oria (S) Quests; the DAT area is sandoria, not crystal_war; and v1 already places atelloune at zone 230. So it is present-day, and the (S) grid collision is a coincidence of the two halves of a WotG past-and-present pair. Both bullets are steps and both are on her, so this is one marker with the trade behind it. Item Reqs says one wing, not four -- Seeing Spots is the four-wing quest.

notes: The trap here is the reward. Rouliette hands you the Holy candle key item, which resolves cleanly as key item 50 and is exactly the sort of thing a keyword pass would latch onto as evidence -- but it is in the header's Reward field, so it proves the quest is over, not that a step is done, and it is deliberately not used. The Lanolin Cube is the real evidence and it sits on the gather step. That gather step comes from bullet 1's sub-bullet, which is unusually load-bearing for a sub-bullet: it is the only place the page says where the cube comes from, and it names Battering Rams in La Theine Plateau. Only that one zone is recorded, because it is the only source with a named monster -- the alternatives are unnamed 'Rams' in Lufaise Meadows, Abyssea - La Theine and Caedarva Mire, and a step has one zone. Those alternatives are flagged rather than modelled; items_partial stays false because the alternative is a different place to find the same item, not a different item.
